acceptanceCriteria: A generation-fenced heartbeat records lastHeartbeatAt without extending the work lease.
Queue and attempt reads distinguish fresh, stale, and unobserved holder signals; stale does not free reservations or prove physical quiescence.
Focused compatibility, stale-generation, TTL and journal tests pass; independent review and linked immutable change evidence are retained.
body:
## Problem

A dead agent's attempt blocks its ticket, and its demo-pool lane, until the work lease expires. Nothing in the queue tells other agents whether the holder is still alive.

Attempts carry one long work lease (60 minutes in our program). When an agent host dies (crash, context exhaustion, host process killed), `queue status` still shows its attempts as `RUNNING` until `expiresAt`. A coordinator then has two options:

- wait for expiry, which blocks the ticket and lane and still costs a retry when it is reaped; or
- guess that the holder is dead and release the attempt on its behalf.

Observed on 2026-10-01 (build `main-d693d28`): an OpenCode orchestrator host exited and took its sub-agents with it. For about 40 minutes the queue held 8 attempts whose holders were dead, two of them with allocated lanes. Successive coordinator sessions could not tell the attempts were orphaned. Some coordinators chose to treat them as live, so nothing ran; others released them, at the risk of cutting off a live agent.

## Request

A liveness signal separate from the work lease, for example:

- `attempt heartbeat` (or `renew --heartbeat`) with a short TTL, such as 5–10 minutes, and `lastHeartbeatAt` shown in `queue status`/`attempt show`;
- a derived state such as `STALE_HOLDER` once the heartbeat TTL passes while the work lease is still valid;
- optionally, a holder-supplied liveness token (host session ID or PID) recorded on claim, so that a supervisor can check it.

Coordinators could then release only provably stale holders, and keep their retries through the `HANDOFF --evidence` path, instead of guessing.


Source: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/426
Baseline: official Tasks build 202 and source cf4c8a39e171d72374e8baadeb744d4105116eda. Reproductions retained under /tmp/corvint-426-428 and /tmp/corvint-428-repro-policy-show.json; holder state currently has no heartbeat fields; policy show returns ERROR; retry projections absent.
